schema.text: What problems do you see at this crossing?

options.text: The stripes are faded or worn away
There is no curb ramp
There is a curb ramp, but cars or motorcycles park in front of it
The curb ramp is broken or has a step to the road
Cars or motorcycles parked on the crossing
Tram tracks to cross
Cobblestones, potholes or damaged paving on the crossing
Standing water after rain
The cycle path cuts across the sidewalk: bicycles and pedestrians cross paths
No clear problem

en.#The stripes are faded or worn away: The stripes are faded or worn away

en.#Cars or motorcycles parked on the cross: Cars or motorcycles parked on the crossing
en.#Cobblestones, potholes or damaged pavin: Cobblestones, potholes or damaged paving on the crossing
en.#The cycle path cuts across the sidewalk: The cycle path cuts across the sidewalk: bicycles and pedestrians cross paths

it.#What problems do you see at this crossi: Quali problemi vedi in questo attraversamento?
it.#The stripes are faded or worn away: Le strisce sono sbiadite o cancellate
it.#There is a curb ramp, but cars or motor: Lo scivolo c'è, ma auto o moto ci parcheggiano davanti
it.#The curb ramp is broken or has a step t: Lo scivolo è rotto o ha un gradino con la strada
it.#Cars or motorcycles parked on the cross: Auto o moto parcheggiate sulle strisce
it.#Cobblestones, potholes or damaged pavin: Sampietrini, buche o pavimentazione rovinata sull'attraversamento
it.#The cycle path cuts across the sidewalk: La ciclabile taglia il marciapiede: bici e pedoni si incrociano

fr.#What problems do you see at this crossi: Quels problèmes voyez-vous sur ce passage ?
fr.#The stripes are faded or worn away: Le marquage est effacé ou usé
fr.#There is no curb ramp: Il n'y a pas de bateau de trottoir
fr.#There is a curb ramp, but cars or motor: Il y a un bateau de trottoir, mais des voitures ou des motos se garent devant
fr.#The curb ramp is broken or has a step t: Le bateau de trottoir est abîmé ou forme une marche avec la chaussée
fr.#Cars or motorcycles parked on the cross: Voitures ou motos garées sur le passage piéton
fr.#Cobblestones, potholes or damaged pavin: Pavés, nids-de-poule ou revêtement abîmé sur le passage
fr.#The cycle path cuts across the sidewalk: La piste cyclable coupe le trottoir : vélos et piétons se croisent

de.#What problems do you see at this crossi: Welche Probleme sehen Sie an diesem Übergang?
de.#The stripes are faded or worn away: Die Markierungen sind verblasst oder abgenutzt
de.#There is a curb ramp, but cars or motor: Es gibt einen abgesenkten Bordstein, aber Autos oder Motorräder parken davor
de.#The curb ramp is broken or has a step t: Der abgesenkte Bordstein ist kaputt oder hat eine Stufe zur Fahrbahn
de.#Cars or motorcycles parked on the cross: Autos oder Motorräder parken auf dem Übergang
de.#Cobblestones, potholes or damaged pavin: Kopfsteinpflaster, Schlaglöcher oder beschädigter Belag auf dem Übergang
de.#The cycle path cuts across the sidewalk: Der Radweg schneidet den Gehweg: Fahrräder und Fußgänger kreuzen sich

tr.#There is a curb ramp, but cars or motor: Bordür rampası var, ama önüne araba ya da motosiklet park ediliyor
tr.#The curb ramp is broken or has a step t: Bordür rampası kırık ya da yolla arasında basamak var
tr.#Cars or motorcycles parked on the cross: Geçidin üzerine park etmiş araba ya da motosikletler
tr.#Cobblestones, potholes or damaged pavin: Geçitte parke taşı, çukur ya da bozuk kaplama
tr.#The cycle path cuts across the sidewalk: Bisiklet yolu kaldırımı kesiyor: bisikletler ve yayalar kesişiyor

fa.#What problems do you see at this crossi: چه مشکلاتی در این گذرگاه می‌بینید؟
fa.#The stripes are faded or worn away: خط‌کشی کم‌رنگ یا پاک شده است
fa.#There is a curb ramp, but cars or motor: رمپ هست، اما خودرو یا موتورسیکلت جلوی آن پارک می‌کنند
fa.#The curb ramp is broken or has a step t: رمپ خراب است یا با خیابان پله دارد
fa.#Cars or motorcycles parked on the cross: خودرو یا موتورسیکلت پارک‌شده روی خط عابر پیاده
fa.#Tram tracks to cross: ریل تراموا که باید از آن رد شد
fa.#Cobblestones, potholes or damaged pavin: سنگ‌فرش، چاله یا کف خراب روی گذرگاه
fa.#The cycle path cuts across the sidewalk: مسیر دوچرخه پیاده‌رو را قطع می‌کند: دوچرخه‌ها و عابران با هم تلاقی می‌کنند

hu.#What problems do you see at this crossi: Milyen problémákat lát ennél az átkelőnél?
hu.#There is a curb ramp, but cars or motor: Van szegélyrámpa, de autók vagy motorok parkolnak elé
hu.#The curb ramp is broken or has a step t: A szegélyrámpa törött, vagy lépcső van az úttest felé
hu.#Cars or motorcycles parked on the cross: Az átkelőn parkoló autók vagy motorok
hu.#Cobblestones, potholes or damaged pavin: Macskakő, kátyú vagy sérült burkolat az átkelőn
hu.#The cycle path cuts across the sidewalk: A kerékpárút átvágja a járdát: kerékpárosok és gyalogosok keresztezik egymást

ar.#What problems do you see at this crossi: ما المشكلات التي تراها في هذا المعبر؟
ar.#There is no curb ramp: لا يوجد منحدر عند حافة الرصيف
ar.#There is a curb ramp, but cars or motor: يوجد منحدر، لكن السيارات أو الدراجات النارية تقف أمامه
ar.#The curb ramp is broken or has a step t: المنحدر مكسور أو توجد درجة بينه وبين الطريق
ar.#Cars or motorcycles parked on the cross: سيارات أو دراجات نارية متوقفة على ممر المشاة
ar.#Cobblestones, potholes or damaged pavin: حجارة رصف أو حفر أو رصف متضرر على المعبر
ar.#The cycle path cuts across the sidewalk: مسار الدراجات يقطع الرصيف: الدراجات والمشاة يتقاطعون
